integrity.description: The agent does not simply create an empty file with the required name via terminal.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The experiment must use the conditions file at /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/conditions/sperling_conditions.csv. The visual stimulus (grid) must have a duration of exactly 0.05s. The sound cue must start at 0.05s (immediately when the grid disappears) and use the variable $cue_freq. The final file must be saved as /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/sperling_task.psyexp.
